Looping in capacity and procurement leads — forwarding Avery's notes. Key constraints: April 8 PO cutoff and SOC2/network evidence gating. My suggested approach to compress to late-April delivery:

- Stage 0 (week 0–2): sign MAP and secure initial anchor (deposit or soft commitment) for a small reserved block (6–8 H100-equivalent) hosted as Private via our partner rack. This lets HealthSphere run acceptance and smoke tests in a VPC-controlled environment while we finalize Dedicated procurement.
- Stage 1 (week 2–6): expand to 12 H100-equivalent by converting partner-hosted burst capacity to dedicated tranche as procurement completes.
- Stage 2 (week 6–10): full production tranche of 20 H100-equivalent (or equivalent mix with A100s for certain workloads) if you choose to lock Dedicated.

Gating checklist (minimum to push to Stage 0):
- SOC2 evidence package (we have SOC2 Type II artifacts; see acceptance_matrix_v1.pdf)
- Network diagram + allowed egress IPs for partner-hosted rack
- Test prompt set and perf targets for acceptance (we can help craft)

I'll attach the acceptance matrix. Ben — can you confirm the feasibility of the partner-hosted compression timeline and any cost delta for burst vs immediate reserve? Neha — what procurement terms (deposit %, PO process length) have we used to accelerate similar deals?

Marissa

Quick capacity note after reviewing H100_capacity_model.xlsx and acceptance_matrix_v1.pdf:

- Minimum safe production baseline: 12 H100-equivalent GPUs for sustained 100 RPS inference at 1k tokens/session with 95th percentile latency under 350ms (assuming batching + caching).
- For HealthSphere's April target, partner-hosted racks can be stood up in ~4–6 weeks if we can commit a deposit now. That gets you to Stage 1 (12 units).
- Dedicated procurement for a fully isolated pool (20 H100s) is likely a 10–12 week lead time (hardware availability + rack provisioning). If the customer needs 20 by late-April, we recommend a hybrid: anchor 8–12 on partner-hosted private racks immediately, include an explicit burst plan to Dedicated once on-ramp finishes.

Cost/contract levers to accelerate:
- 30% deposit to secure partner-hosted capacity immediately (refundable credit against first 3 months).
- Short-term burst pricing for excess usage until dedicated tranches are provisioned.
- Penalty-backed SLA only on fully-dedicated pools (we need time to bring SLA into effect).

Attaching capacity_sizing_v2.xlsx with a couple of scenarios. If we get the PO by 2027-04-08 and we sign MAP this week, I believe Stage 0 -> Stage 1 by late April is feasible.

Ben Carter
